attack: the pre-file-list stamp (no corpusFiles) replayed onto a layer that has since grown
why: a report that cannot say which receipts it hashed has not measured a corpus; UNMEASURED is its own answer and must NOT be reported as STALE
wouldBeWrongIf: READY (the 2026-11-01 replay that this vector was discovered by), or STALE -- two answers on one failure

expects.expectMessagePattern: does not name the files it measured

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_RECOMPUTE_UNMEASURED: no corpusFiles means the gate cannot recompute fidelity either: the same missing list, read twice
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_MISMATCH: the claim 67/0 cannot be reproduced from an unnamed list, so the mismatch is a consequence of the same defect
